Commentary.Commentary: Rangana Herath was the pick of the bowlers for the Lankans. The home side toiled hard but could not get timely wickets. The target is big and it won't be easy batting last on this surface. The Lankan batsmen will have to apply themselves if they want to stay in the contest. Join us for the chase in a while.

So, Sri Lanka finally bowl Zimbabwe out. They will be chasing a mammoth 388 to win this game. The last three wickets added 71 crucial runs after the wicket of Raza. Graeme Cremer had a good time with the bat as well after taking a 5-fer. He was well supported by Tiripano who played a gritty innings.

OUT! 6-fer for Herath and this is his 11th wicket of the game! Good bowling display from him and he gets the Zimbabwe skipper. A good knock from Graeme nonetheless. Slow through the air in line of the stumps, Cremer kneels and looks to sweep it but gets a top edge. The ball lobs over the keeper. Karunaratne moves to his left from first slip and pouches it comfortably. ZIMBABWE HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 377!
Fullish delivery and quicker in pace, Mpofu defends it.
This one comes in with the arm, Chris keeps it out.
Quicker delivery on middle and leg, defended to short leg.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

In the air... but safe! Floated outside off, Cremer uses his feet but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. As a result, he ends up chipping it towards long off. The fielder moves in to take it but it falls just short of him. A run taken!
Stays back to this one and defends it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

SIX! High and handsome! What a strike from the No. 11! Tossed up in line of the stumps, Mpofu swings across the line and does it with a lot of flair. Has hit that really well and the ball clears the deep mid-wicket fence with ease.
Graeme uses his feet and chips it uppishly to long on for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, played with soft hands to covers.
Slow through the air outside leg, Chris kneels and sweeps it towards fine leg for a run.
Cremer uses his feet and Herath bowls it quicker outside off. He jams it out through mid off and decides to take a run. Moves to 46 with that.
Floated on off, pushed towards long on. Cremer denies the single. He wants to keep strike.
Waits for this one and nudges it quietly through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated around off, spinning in. Mpofu prods forward to defend but gets it off the outer half to point. A run taken.
Cremer uses his feet and chips it to long off for a single.
Full delivery outside off, Cremer goes for the reverse sweep but misses it.
Fullish delivery, Chris defends it tentatively.

Not out! Unsuccessful review! The height is the factor which saves the batsman. Tossed up around leg stump, spinning away. Mpofu looks to flick it but misses to get struck on the pads. There is a loud appeal for an LBW but the umpire shakes his head. Chandimal has a chat with Herath and decides to take the review. Time for the replays. The Hawk Eye shows that it is pitching in line and the impact is in line but it would have gone over the stumps.
Sri Lanka have taken a review for LBW against Mpofu. Looks close. Height might be an issue.
Floated on off, Chris defends it to the leg side.
Flaoted on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Looks to paddle this one from around off but wears it on the pads.
Flatter on leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, Chris comes forward to defend tentatively but gets an inside edge to mid-wicket.

Not out! Quicker through the air outside off, Mpofu looks to play for the turn but it goes straight on to beat him. Dickwella takes the bails off in a flash. It is referred upstairs. The replays show that Chris had has foot inside the crease.
The Lankans have appealed for a stumping and the umpire goes upstairs.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. One run added to the total.
Spinning into Mpofu, he gets an inside edge past short leg for a run.
Chris Mpofu is the last man in.

OUT! Finally a breakthrough for Sri Lanka! Perera bowls this one quicker through the air and it spins into Tiripano. He hangs deep in the crease and looks to flick it on the leg side but misses to get pinged on the front pad. A confident appeal follows and umpire Nigel Llong has no hesitation in ruling that one out. That looked quite plumb. Perera gets his third wicket. A good resistance from Donald comes to an end. Zimbabwe lead by 371 runs!

That was hilarious! Tossed up delivery, Tiripano eases it down the track towards Perera. He dives to his right but the ball spins and foxes him. It goes past him down to mid off. The players have a laugh about it.
A bit short this time, Graeme defends it solidly.

Almost a run out! Tiripano turns it against the spin to mid-wicket. He is ball watching but sets off. His partner also hesitates but they decide to eventually go for the run. The throw is at the striker's end which is the wrong one. Cremer makes it in safely.
Quicker one down the leg side, Donald looks to pull it but misses.
Driven towards the mid on region.

FOUR! Shot! So much of confidence in the way he played that. Tossed up outside leg, Tiripano backs away, dances down the track and lifts it over mid on for a boundary. The message might have come from the dressing room to up the ante.
Stays back to this one and keeps it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
In line of the stumps, turned to mid-wicket.
Floated on off, Cremer lunges forward to defend it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.
50-run stand up between Graeme Cremer and Donald Tiripano.

Dropped! Shoddy catching at its peak. Slow through the air outside off, Tiripano comes down the track and drives it uppishly towards Lahiru Kumara. He takes a couple of steps forward and gets into a tangle. Tries to catch it near his chest but the ball goes right through to hit him in that area. Then it falls down on the ground. If you don't take such dollies, you are making life really difficult for yourself. Single taken.
Fullish around the pads, kept off the front foot.
Herath opts for the leg stump line again. Cremer sweeps it to short fine leg.
Flatter delivery, turning away. Cremer hangs back and punches it towards mid off.
Kneels and sweeps this one around the corner for a single.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, played with soft hands to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside leg, turning away. Tiripano pads it away.
Back of a length delivery in the channel outside off, the Zimbabwe skipper points his bat skywards to let it through.
Length delivery shaping in sharply into Graeme. He defends it with the full face of the bat to mid on. That was really a confident defensive stroke.
A well-directed bouncer on off, Cremer ducks under it. Good pace on that one.
Fuller in length on middle and leg, Graeme nudges it through square leg. Quite some work for the fielder in the deep as he gets to his left to cut it off. Two runs taken.
Bouncer around off, Cremer sways away from the line of the delivery to evade it. Shoulders are dropping for the home side. They need to keep up the intensity.
Length delivery on off, Cremer covers the line to pat it to the off side.
Landed on off, Tiripano gets forward to defend it.
Flighted delivery on off, stroked through to sweeper cover for a single.
Good variation! Pushed quicker through the air, defended solidly off the front foot to silly point.
Tossed up outside off, eased towards short extra cover where the fielder moves to his right to stop it.
Two Leg byes! Drifting down the leg side, Graeme misses his glance as the ball brushes his pads to go to fine leg. Two leg byes taken.
Floated in line of the stumps, Cremer lunges forward in defense.
Leg sidish line again, easy pickings for Cremer who helps it to fine leg for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Short delivery on off, better directed this time. Cremer drops his wrists and gets out of the way.

Two Leg byes! Angling into the hips, Cremer looks to tuck it around but gets hit on the thigh pad. The ball goes past the keeper and towards fine leg. Lakmal in the deep runs to his right and slides to make a good stop. Two leg byes taken.
Bouncer outside off, Graeme lets it off. Kumara hasn't been able to maintain proper lines and lengths.
Short of a length delivery around off, Cremer hops and taps it to covers.
That was close! Drifting in with the arm, Donald is hurried by it but manages to get an inside edge. It falls to the left side of the short leg fielder.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Looks to reverse sweep this fullish delivery outside off but only manages to get a bottom edge towards first slip.
Well bowled! Slow through the air around off, Tiripano prods forward to defend but is beaten by the away turn.
Tossed up delivery, pushed to mid off.

FOUR! Easy pickings! Flatter and shorter delivery on leg stump, Tiripano makes good use of the crease and turns it through mid-wicket. Two fielders hare after it but fail to prevent the boundary. Donald is showing that he is no mug with the bat.
Rangana Herath to continue his spell.
Dug in short on off, a well-directed bouncer. Cremer sways away from the line of the delivery to evade it.
Angling into the hips this time, Graeme Cremer works it through mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
Full length delivery outside off, the Zimbabwe skipper drives it crisply to covers where the fielder dives to his left to make a good stop.
Low full toss this time, tailing in nicely to Cremer. He pushes it to short extra cover.
Good length delivery angling in from outside off, Graeme stands tall and defends it stoutly.
Full length delivery outside off, holding its line. Cremer plants his front foot across and lets it go.
The men concerned are out in the middle. Graeme Cremer and Donald Tiripano will continue their innings. Lahiru Kumara will start off the bowling proceedings.
...Day 4, Session 2...

Just at the stroke of lunch, Karunaratne dropped a difficult chance of Cremer. The skipper is batting well and is adding some handy runs for his side with Tiripano providing good resistance. A score of above 400 can prove to be really difficult to chase. However, it is still a decent track to bat on. Join us for the second session in a while.

Zimbabwe have played well in the morning session for a change and the lead has swelled to 350 runs. Though Waller gifted his wicket away, he played a great hand for his side. Raza scored his maiden Test ton and it could well turn out to be a game-defining one. The veteran, Herath got the better of him but till then, a lot of damage was already done.
Covers are coming in as the umpires have called for an early lunch. Fortunately, the sun is also breaking through and the drizzle is not threatening.
Tiripano shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Drags his length back a little, Tiripano gets an inside edge back to the bowler as he tries to cut the ball.
Dances down the track and defends it off the front foot.
It has started drizzling.
Floats it on middle, turning away. Donald gets an outside edge wide of second slip.
Quicker one on middle, Tiripano lunges forward and defends it.
Lands it on middle, the batsman defends it solidly.
Floats it on off, Cremer defends it off the front foot.
Works it around the corner with the spin for a run. Lead touches 350 now.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Comes down the track and blocks the ball.
Brings out the reverse sweep and hits it down to third man for a couple.

DROPPED ! A tough chance but could have been taken. Perera tosses it up outside off, goes straight on with the arm. Cremer tries to defend it but gets an outside edge. The ball goes fast and low to the right of Karunaratne at slip, who dives and gets a hand to it but can't catch it. The ball rolls towards third man and the batsman run three.
Flighted ball on middle, Tiripano lunges forward and block it.
Floats it on off, Tiripano defends it by covering the line of the ball.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Comes down the track and hits it back to the bowler who half stops it and the ball rolls towards covers.
Floats it up on off, turning away. Cremer drives it square through the off side for a run.
Tosses it up on leg stump, the batsman defends it watchfully.
Flatter on the pads, Tiripano misses the flick and is struck on the pads. There is a muted appeal from the Lankans but nothing from the umpire.
Bowls it on the pads, Cremer works it around the corner for a run.
Floats it up outside off, turning back in. Cremer defends it solidly.
Comes down the track and drives it straight back to the bowler who has a shy at the striker's end but Cremer is safe.
Tosses it on off, skids through. Cremer defends it off the front foot.
Tickles it to fine leg with the spin for a run.
Dilruwan Perera is back on. Can he get his side a breakthrough before lunch?
Loopy ball on off, Cremer defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Crunches this sweep shot through square leg for another boundary. The visitors have played the sweep shot really well.
Tosses it on off, Cremer defends it off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Darts it down the leg side, Cremer sweeps it fine past the keeper and the ball races to the fine leg fence. Important runs these for Zimbabwe. Replays show that it came off the gloves.
Fires it in on leg stump, Cremer defends it off the back foot.
A tad fuller on off, the batsman drives it to mid off.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Tiripano gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Length ball outside off, Tiripano guides it to gully.
Lands it on a length outside off, Cremer guides it through point. They run one, Tiripano wants a second but is sent back by Cremer.
Sprays it on the pads, Cremer flicks it down to fine leg for a couple. Good running by the skipper.
Good length on off, Cremer defends it off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gives it air and bowls it full, Tiripano drives it to mid off.
Slower thorugh the air on off, the batsman defends it by covering the line of the ball.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Filghted ball on off, the batsman drives it to cover.

Angles it into the batsman, Cremer flicks it to mid-wicket.

Suranga Lakmal is back into the attack.
Flighted on off, Cremer defends it solidly.
Flatter on middle, coming in with the arm. Cremer keeps it out.
FOUR! Comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Drifts it on the pads, the batsman flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
Tosses it on leg stump, Tiripano defends it off the front foot.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
FOUR! Lahiru has been unlucky. Bowls it on a length outside off, Cremer gets an outside edge through the slip cordon and the ball races to the third man fence. Kumara is getting frustrated.
Aims it at the ribs of the batsman who flicks it down to deep square leg for a run.
Bouncer on leg stump, the batsman ducks under it.
Good length outside off, Tiripano guides it towards second slip who makes a good diving stop to his right.
A tad fuller on middle, Tiripano drives it to mid off.
Back of a length outside off, Cremer pushes it towards point for a run.
Sweeps it to fine leg for a run.
Floats it on off, Cremer defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up, skids in off the wicket. Tiripano gets an inside edge past the leg stump and the batsmen take a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Donald Tiripano is the new man in.

OUT! Herath gets a 10 wicket-haul! His 8th Test 10-fer. A true champion and he gets the big wicket of Raza who has played a terrific knock. Bowls it a little quicker on middle and it goes straight on with the arm. Raza tries to play the reverse sweep which he has played so well but misses the ball this time and it shatters the stumps. Raza walks back dejected but he has played a game-changing innings here. He walks off to a standing ovation. Zimbabwe lead by 316.
Raza paddles this fine through short fine leg for a couple. The fielder scores a direct hit but no hard done.
Lands it on a length outside off, the batsman lets it through to the keeper.
Full and outside off, Cremer lets it through to the keeper.
WIDE! Bangs it in short on middle, it bounces way above the batsman's end. The umpire calls it a wide.
Full and wide outside off, Raza slaps it through point for a run.
Lands it on a length outside off, Cremer plays it through point for a run.
Lands it on a length on off, Cremer defends it solidly. The new ball is not doing a lot here.
Bangs it short on off, Raza guides it through backward point for a run.

Time for Drinks. Zimbabwe have gone along well in the first hour. They have added 48 runs and lost only one wicket. Sri Lanka, on the other hand will want to take quick wickets with the new ball as the lead has gone over 300.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. Maiden to start with.
CLOSE! Bowls an arm ball on middle, Cremer gets it off the inner half on the bounce to short leg.
Flighted ball outside off, Cremer tries to sweep it but does not connect.
Slower through the air, turns away. Cremer pokes at it and gets beaten.
Floats it on middle, the batsman lunges forward and defends it.
Tosses it up on off, Cremer strides forward and defends it.
Rangana Herath to share the new ball from the other end.
Good length on off, Sikandar defends it by covering the line of the ball.
length on middle, Raza defends it off the back foot.
Bangs it in short outside off, Raza tries to cut but gets beaten.
Very full outside off, Cremer jams it out to point. The fielder misfields and concedes a run. 300 up for Zimbabwe.
Second slip moves a bit wider.
FOUR! STREAKY BOUNDARY! Full and wide outside off, Cremer tries to drives it but gets an outside edge between gully and second slip for a boundary.
Lands it on a length on off, Cremer defends it off the back foot.
Lahiru Kumara comes back into the attack. Two slips and a gully in place.
The second new ball is available and it has been taken straightaway. The reviews have been refreshed for both the sides as well.
Sprays on the pads, the batsman flicks it to square leg for a run.
A tad fuller outside off, Cremer defends it with the full face of the bat.
Angles it on the pads, Cremer flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Slower full ball outside off, Raza drives it square on the off side for a run.
A tad short on off, Raza pulls it straight to mid-wicket.
Lands it on a length, Raza pushes it to mid on.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up on off, Cremer defends it by coming forward.
Shorter delivery outside off, Cremer stays back and pushes it to the off side.
Floats it on off, Cremer defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up outside off, gets some sharp turn into the batsman. Cremer tries to cut but gets a bottom edge onto the ground.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full ball on off, Raza defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Lands it on a length on middle, Raza prods forward and defends it watchfully.
Back of a length on off, Sikandar defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Full and on the pads, Cremer tries to flick it but misses. The ball brushes his pads and rolls towards fine leg. There is a muted appeal but nothing from the umpire. It was missing leg. The batsmen take a leg bye.
A tad short outside off, Raza punches it through the off side for a run. The lead touches 300.
The skipper, Graeme Cremer strides out to bat.

OUT! Waller what have you done? This was so needless. Dilruwan drags his length back on leg stump, a nothing delivery actually. Waller camps back and pulls it uppishly straight to Tharanga at deep mid-wicket who takes an easy catch. It was a poor delivery, he could have hit it anywhere but he hit it straight to the fielder. Waller who played a brilliant knock has thrown it away. The 144-run stand has been broken by Dilruwan Perera. Sri Lanka would be relieved after this wicket. Zimbabwe lead by 299.
Loopy ball on leg stump, Raza drives it down to long on for a run.
Bowls it on the pads, Waller flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it up on middle, Raza drives it to long on for a run.
Plays the sweep this time down to fine leg for a run.
Brings out the reverse sweep and hits it down to sweeper cover for a run.
Dilruwan Perera is back into the attack.
Lands it on a length outside off, Raza guides it down to third man for a run. Umpire Ian Gould tells Sikandar to be careful as he ran close to the danger area.
Just ahead of a length, Raza gets it off the inner half to mid on.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Full and on middle, Raza shows the full face of the bat and drives it through mid on for a boundary. They have started the session really well today.
Lands it on a length on off, Raza defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Back of a length on middle, Waller pushes it through covers for a run.
Slower ball on off, Waller defends it towards covers.
Suranga Lakmal to bowl now.
Drives it with the spin through covers for a run. This is now the highest 7th wicket partnership for Zimbabwe against Sri Lanka.
Loopy ball on middle, turning away. Malcolm defends it solidly.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tosses it up on middle, Waller defends it off the front foot.
Quicker and full on off, Raza drives it down to long off for a run.
Bowls an arm ball, Waller flicks it with the angle on the leg side for a run.
During the break, the replays show that Ian Gould gave an official warning to Lahiru Kumara for landing on the danger area. He needs to be careful.
Full and tailing in from outside off, Sikandar flicks it to short mid-wicket where the fielder makes a tumbling stop.
Full and on off, Waller drives it towards mid off for a run.
Full and on the pads, Raza flicks it through backward square leg for a run.
FOUR! Bangs it in short on the body of the batsman. Raza tickles it down to fine leg for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Yes it is missing leg stump! Very full ball swinging in on leg stump, Waller misses the flick and is pinged on the pads and the ball rolls towards fine leg. The Sri Lankans make a loud appeal but the umpire stays put. Chandimal after a chat with the bowler decides to review it. They go upstairs. Replays show there is no inside edge. The ball pitches in line but is missing the leg stump. On-field call stays. Sri Lanka lose a review. It looked not out. The hosts must have got excited with the fact that Waller had shuffled a long way across. The batsmen run a leg bye.
Sri Lanka have taken a review for LBW against Waller. It might just miss leg stump.
Length on pads, Waller flicks it to mid-wicket.

Drives it to long on for a run.

Loopy ball on middle, turns away from the batsman. Raza tries to play it through the off side but gets an outside edge to backward point.
Flatter delivery outside off, Raza slaps it through covers. Dilruwan makes good ground to his right, dives and makes a good stop. 2 runs taken.
Angles it on the pads, Waller nudges it towards square leg. He sets off for a run. There is a little hesitation in between but they go through for the run and no harm done.
Some reverse swing there for Lahiru. Full and tailing back in. Raza drives it to short extra cover.

Chandimal gets into a chat with Herath, Perera and Kumara. Might be about the field settings. The young pace bowler to continue.
Slower through the air, turns away a little. Waller prods forward and defends it.
Drags his length back a little, Waller pushes it to covers.
Bowls an arm ball on leg stump, Raza drives it through mid on for a run.
Loopy ball on middle, Raza defends it solidly.
Tosses it on middle, Raza defends it off the front foot.
Drifts it on the pads, Waller tries to flick but misses and the ball brushes his pads and goes towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Rangana Herath comes into the attack. A slip and leg gully in place.
Fullish ball on middle, Raza drives it to mid off.
Sprays it down the leg side, Raza misses his flick and the ball goes through to the keeper.
A tad fuller on middle, Sikandar drives it to mid on.
Good length on off, Raza defends it off the back foot.
Lands it on a length on off, Raza defends it off the front foot.
Low full toss on leg stump, Kumara flicks it towards short mid-wicket. Dilruwan Perera there makes a mess of it and concedes a run.
Lahiru Kumara to bowl from the other end.
Flatter outside off, Waller pushes it towards point for a run.
Tossed up on off, Waller defends it off the front foot.
Whips it to long on for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Maiden Test ton for Sikandar Raza.

That is it! He has got to his hundred and he is ecstatic. He jumps and punches the air in joy, just shows what it means to him. Coming back to the ball, Perera dragged his length back outside off, Raza punched it through covers for a couple. It has been a brilliant knock by him.
Mid off in place now.

NOT OUT! Starts off with a very full ball outside off, Raza drives it through cover-point and sets off. Herath is quick to the ball and makes a good throw at the non-striker's end. The batsmen go for the second run as Dilruwan collects the ball and takes the bails off. They go upstairs to check but Waller has made his ground. Raza moves onto 99. An action-packed first ball.
They have referred for a run out at the non-striker's end. Seems safe though.

We are ready to get underway. The players and the umpires come out in the middle. Sikandar Raza and Malcolm Waller to continue their innings. Dilruwan Perera to start off the proceedings with the ball. A slip and short leg in place. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Alistair Campbell and Russel Arnold ask Graeme Cremer about the wicket and he feels it is a good wicket. Mentions it will start to turn in the afternoon session. Opines it has not changed a lot. Informs there is a little rough outside the leg stump but if you play yourself in, you can score a lot of runs.

The second new ball is 12 overs away and in the course of that, the tourists can run away with the show. The hosts need to dominate the morning session if they are to stay in the contest. For that, the wily Rangana Herath needs to run through the rest of the batting line-up. The track is still decent to bat on with the odd ball gripping and turning. Expect an eventful day of cricket!

Hello and a warm welcome for Day 4 of the one-off Test between Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe in Colombo. The visitors are controlling the proceedings at the moment on the back of a terrific show from their lower middle order. Raza is only 3 shy of his maiden Test ton while Waller is playing the perfect foil to him. With Cremer and Tiripano who have first-class centuries to their name still to come, the hosts have a lot to worry.
...Day 4, Session 1...

Contrary to expectations, the wicket hasn't deteriorated and run scoring is not that difficult. Zimbabwe hold the aces at the moment but tomorrow morning will be a crucial passage of play. Sri Lanka will want their ace spinner, Rangana Herath to get back into his elements. Can Zimbabwe set a target somewhere around 350 or will Sri Lanka bowl them out under 300? Tomorrow itself could decide the fate of this match. Join us at 1000 local (0430 GMT) to catch all the action. Till then, cheers!

A special mention has to be given to Sikandar Raza. He had fitness issues but he kept fighting for the cause of his side. He is unbeaten on 97 and has been solid as a rock. Waller from the other end is playing a great hand as well. It has been a near flawless effort on their part to bail their side out of trouble. Before that, Peter Moor also played a gritty knock to give some sort of momentum.

What a terrific comeback from Zimbabwe! They lead by 262 now with four wickets in hand. They were staring down the barrel when they were 59/5 but it has been a revival of sorts! It looked like the wily Herath will run through the batting line-up but it wasn't to be. The visitors once again showed that they are a courageous side. They kept scoring briskly and didn't allow the opposition to get on top.
Tosses it on off, Waller defends it off the front foot. THAT IS STUMPS ON DAY 3.
Plays the paddle sweep down to fine leg for a run.
FOUR! What a shot to play in the last over of the day. Dances down the track and lofts it over covers for a boundary. Top shot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Comes down the track and defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up outside off, Waller drives it through covers for a run.
Rangana Herath to bowl the last over of the day. Can he sneak in a wicket?
Lands it on a length outside off, Malcolm guides it to point for a run.
Sprays it down the leg side, Malcol lets it through to the keeper.
Good length on off, Waller defends it off the front foot.
100-run stand between Sikandar Raza and Malcolm Waller.
Back of a length on off, Waller guides it towards point for a couple.
Full ball outside off, Waller drives it through cover-point for a run.
A tad fuller tailing back into the batsman who drives it to mid on.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
Comes down the track and gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a run.
Full ball outside off, Raza drives it to covers.
Drives it down it back to the bowler who misfields and a single is taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tosses it up on off, Waller defends it off the back foot.
Sikandar Raza is getting his left side of the body stretched.
Slower ball on off, Raza defends it off the front foot.
Lands it on a length on off, Raza drives it to covers.
Full ball tailing back in on off, Raza drives it to mid off.
Bouncer on middle, Raza ducks under it.
Lands it on a length on middle, Waller tries to flick it but misses and the ball strikes his pads and goes towards point. Leg bye taken.
An appeal in desperation! Lands it on a length, jags back in a little. Waller gets an inside edge onto his pads. Lankans appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Loopy ball on off, Raza prods forward and defends it.
Flatter on the stumps, Raza defends it off the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floats it on middle, Raza wrists it past the bowler to mid on.
Comes down the track and defends it solidly.
Tosses it on middle, turning back in. Raza gets it off the inner edge through square leg for a couple.
Dilruwan Parera is back into the attack.
A HUGE APPEAL! Full and tailing back in, Malcolm walks across and tries to flick it but misses. The Lankans appeal but the umpire gives it not out. Replays show there was an inside edge.
Bangs in a short ball outside off, Waller lets it through to the keeper.
Good length on off, Waller pushes it to covers.
Lands it on a length on off, Raza defends it to covers.
Back of a length on off, Waller punches it through covers for a run.
A tad fuller outside off, the batsman drives it through covers for a run.
Lahiru Kumara has been brought back into the attack.
Comes down the track and defends it off the front foot.
Flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Drags his length back, Waller pulls it straight to the backward square leg fielder.
Drives it with the spin to covers.
Tosses it up on leg stump, Waller defends it off the front foot.
Short fine leg goes to square leg.
Bowls it down the leg side, Raza sweeps it to fine leg for a run.
The umpire is passing the ball through the 8-shaped gauge. However, it is fine to continue.
Comes back over the wicket and digs it in short. The batsman ducks under it.
4th Test fifty for Malcolm Waller.
FOUR! CRACKED! Full and outside off from around the wicket. Waller drives it through extra cover for a boundary.
Lands it on a length on off, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
Good length outside off, Waller guides it down to third man for a couple.
Bangs it in short on middle, Raza pulls it to long leg for a run.
A tad fuller, tailing back in off stump, Raza defends it off the back foot.
Quicker one on leg stump, turning away. Waller defends it off the front foot.
Sweeps it in the air but safely towards short fine leg for a run.
Bowls it outside leg, Raza sweeps it to short fine leg.
Plays the sweep shot to deep square leg for a run.
Tosses it up on leg stump, Waller defends it off the front foot.
A tad short outside leg, Malcolm tries to pull it but misses and is struck on the pads.
Slower short ball on the stumps, Raza defends it off the back foot.
Bowls it on a length on off, Sikandar defends it off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, Raza drives it to covers.
Good length on the stumps, Raza defends it solidly.
A tad fuller outside off, Waller drives it to deep point for a run.
Lands it on a length on off, Raza punches it through covers for a run.
Suranga Lakmal is back into the attack.
The batsman plays a sweep shot straight to short fine leg.

JUST SHORT! Slower through the air on leg stump, Waller tries to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge towards silly point. Kusal Mendis dives ahead but the ball falls just short of him. Everything is going the visitors' way now.
Plays the sweep shot straight to short fine leg.
FOUR! WOW! One of the toughest shots in the game. Comes down the track and hits it inside out over covers for a boundary. This is a vital knock from Waller.
Very full on leg stump, Raza drives it back past the bowler for a run.
Floats it on off, Raza defends it off the front foot.

BIG APPEAL! Loopy ball, sliding in. Waller tries to defend it but is beaten by the turn and the ball hits the pads. The Lankans appeal but nothing from the umpire. The replays show there was an inside edge there.
Very full outside off, Waller mistimes it to covers.
Floats it up on middle, Waller defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! This is very good batting. Tosses it up on middle, Waller slog sweeps it with the spin over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flatter outside off, the batsman cuts it through point for a couple.
Tosses it outside off, Malcolm defends it off the front foot.
A tad short on off, Raza punches it to covers.
Was there an edge? No there was no edge there! Raza comes down the track and tries to work it on the leg side. However, the ball goes off the pads to first slip who dives ahead and takes it nicely.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy ball on leg stump, Waller drives it to mid on for a run.
Bowled outside leg stump, Waller tries to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge safely back to the bowler.
Tosses it on leg stump, Waller defends it off the front foot.
Short and outside off, Waller cuts it through point for a run.
Bowled outside off, Waller defends it off the back foot.
Silly point in place now.
Pushed to cover-point by the batsman for a run.
Plays the reverse sweep to great effect to the man at deep point. Good aggressive running helps them take two.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Plays it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Floats it on leg stump, Waller tries to sweep but is hit on the pads. 11 runs off the over.
Comes down to the pitch of the ball and drives it to long on for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Raza prods forward and defends it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
SIX! A fielder down at long on, no problem! Advances down the track and plays the helicopter shot over the long on fence for a maximum. He is taking the attack to Herath.

FOUR! Great use of the feet. Raza is playing a gem of a knock. Herath tosses it up on leg stump, Raza comes down the track and flicks it over mid-wicket. Kumara in the deep makes a good effort to stop the ball but to no avail.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
50-run stand between Sikandar Raza and Malcolm Waller.
Full on leg stump, Raza drives it to long on for a run.
Comes down the track and hits it straight to covers who makes a good stop. That was hit hard.
Flatter on middle, Raza defends it off the back foot.
Drags his length back on the stumps, Waller punches it down to long on for a run.
Tries to drive it on the off side against the spin but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Flighted ball on off, Raza defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Loopy ball on off, Raza defends it solidly.
Good work by the fielder at leg gully. Angles it into the pads, Raza tries to tuck it past leg gully but the fielder dives to his right and makes a good stop.
Tosses it up on off, Raza defends it off the front foot.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Floats it on leg, turning away. Malcolm plays it awkwardly with an open face towards point for a run.
Plays it with the spin to the leg side.
Loopy ball outside off, Perera drives it to covers.
Comes down the track and almost yorks himself but does well to jam the ball out.
Full ball on middle, Raza whips it through mid-wicket. Upul Tharanga makes good ground to his left and dives and pushes the ball back in. Two runs taken.
Shorter outside off, Waller guides it towards point for a run.
Tosses it up, turning back in. Malcolm gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.

Time for Drinks. Raza and Waller are amidst a flourishing partnership. The latter has played some gorgeous looking strokes and is putting pressure on the bowlers. The lead has swelled to 199 runs. Sri Lanka will start to feel the heat now. They need to break this threatening stand as soon as possible.
Short delivery outside off, Malcolm slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Well played! Tossed up outside leg stump, Waller kneels and sweeps it against the spin. Gets it through fine leg and the ball rolls to the fence. Moves onto 26 from 23.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Plays this one to backward point with the spin.
Floated outside off, Raza uses his feet to play an expansive shot but skews it off the outer half to sweeper cover. A run taken.
Tossed up delivery, Raza comes down the track and defends it to the off side.
Change of ends for Rangana Herath.
Slower through the air in line of the stumps, Waller lunges forward in defense.
Fullish delivery on middle, knocked down to long on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated on off, a solid defense by Sikandar.
Tossed up delivery, played off the outer half past slip for a run.

FOUR! Malcolm is looking dangerous. A bit short around off, spinning away. Waller cuts it uppishly through backward point. Herath covers a lot of ground to his left and slides. He stops it with his left hand but however, makes a mess of it to parry it behind to the ropes.
Dilruwan Parera is back into the attack.
Fuller length delivery tailing into Raza. Pushed towards mid on.
Short delivery but it is going down the leg side, Raza moves inside the line to let it go.

Back of a length on off, Sikandar taps it towards covers and calls for a single initially. However, he notices that the fielder is quick to attack the ball and sends Waller back. Strong early call from him and the non-striker gets home safely.
Kumara is in great rhythm! Bowls a yorker around off, Raza jams it out towards wide gully.
Length delivery on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Straying on the pads, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Coming in with the arm, Raza keeps it out.
Tossed up outside off, Raza goes for a booming drive but gets it off the outer half towards bacwkward point. However, it falls wide of the fielder.
Loopy delivery outside off, driven sweetly to sweeper cover for a run.
This one skids in with the arm. Sikandar rocks back and cuts it through point for a single.
Floated around off, eased to covers.
Flatter delivery in line of the stumps, Raza makes room and plays it back to the bowler.
Good comeback from Kumara! Hurls in a yorker outside off and gets it to tail in. Waller goes for a drive but is beaten. 10 from the over.

FOUR! Exquisite! Full length delivery outside off, Waller creams it through covers and the ball whistles away to the fence. He has played a couple of great looking shots. Zimbabwe will want him to keep going.
Length delivery outside off, Waller mistimes his punch to the off side.

Fuller in length and tailing in sharply again, Waller wrists it in the gap between the two catching short mid-wicket fielders. The batsmen go for the second as the fielder from the deep returns a good throw to the bowler's end but misses. Replays show if that hit, Raza was a goner. There were three fielders near the stumps but no one came close to it to collect the ball. Small basic things need to be taken care of.

FOUR! Text book stuff from Waller! Back of a length delivery angling in from outside off, Malcolm stands tall and punches it elegantly through covers. The substitute, Chameera hares after it and slides near the fence to stop it but fails.
Kumara looks to generate reverse swing again but slips this one down the leg side, Waller misses his flick.
Floated outside off, driven with an open face through point for a single.
Raza uses his feet and drills it to the fielder at covers. He misfields and parries it towards long off. A run taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drifting in towards the batsman. He counters it by leaning forward.
Floated around off, Raza lunges forward in defense.
Smart bowling from Herath! Sees Raza using his feet and darts it on a fullish length outside off. Raza ends up yorking himself but manages to keep it out towards point.
Rangana Herath is back on.
Stays back to the good length delivery and eases it to the off side.
Kumara goes wide of the crease and angles in a length delivery to Sikandar.  He stands tall and pushes it to short extra cover.
Straying on the hips, helped on its way to fine leg for a single.
Similar length delivery outside off, Raza drives it with an open face through point. Good aggressive running from the batsmen to come back for two.
Fullish delivery shaping into Sikandar. Driven crisply to short extra cover.

FOUR! Beautiful! Raza is playing a great hand for his side. Length delivery outside off, Sikandar lunges forward and times his cover drive to perfection. The fielder inside the ring dives to his right but it goes past him and through to the fence.
Wide! Short delivery but it is very short. Raza ducks under it easily. The umpire also calls one bouncer for the over.
FOUR! Well played! Flatter delivery again, Waller makes good use of the crease and whips it through mid-wicket. He has hit that well and the ball races to the fence.
Flatter on off, clipped to front of square on the leg side for a single. 150 up for Zimbabwe!
Slower through the air outside off, defended off the front foot.
Flighted delivery, Sikandar lunges forward in defense.
Tossed up around off, Raza goes for the reverse sweep but is hit near the elbow. The ball lobs towards leg slip.
Floated delivery, Raza gets it off the inner half through the leg side.
Bouncer around off, Waller sways away from it. Successful over for Sri Lanka.
Back of a length on off, defended solidly off the back foot.

Kumara is generating good inward shape. Gets this one to curl back from wide of the crease into Malcolm appreciably. He looks to keep it out but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls to mid-wicket.
The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Lahiru Kumara has been given a warning for running on the danger area.
That almost knocked the leg stump! Fullish delivery tailing down leg sharply, Waller looks to get some bat on it but fails. The ball just goes past the leg stump and through to the fine leg fence.
Malcolm Waller is the new man in.

OUT! The bowling change has done the trick! Kumara is all pumped up! Good field placement by Chandimal as well. Dug in short, Moor takes on the pull shot and plays it decently. However, he doesn't bother keeping it down. The ball flies straight towards the substitute fielder, Danushka Gunathilaka who is positioned a fair distance up from the deep square leg boundary ropes. He lines it up and takes it comfortably. The 86-run stand comes to an end. Crucial breakthrough for the hosts. Zimbabwe lead by 155 runs.
Lahiru Kumara comes into the attack.
Length delivery on middle, defended solidly.
Raza turns it with the spin past short mid-wicket. A yes and no situation between the batsmen as the fielder there runs after it. Dot ball.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.

In the air... but safe! Slow through the air on off, Raza goes for the sweep but his bottom hand comes off. Ends up getting a top edge that falls short of the deep backward square leg fielder. A run taken.
Uses his feet to the tossed up delivery outside off and pats it to covers.
Risky! Flatter delivery, Moor stays back and plays it uppishly past the left side of the bowler. Single taken.
Back of a length outside off, Raza dabs it with an open face to wide gully.
Short delivery in line of the stumps, Peter pulls it nicely through front of square on the leg side for a single.
Short of a length outside off, Raza places it towards cover-point. The fielder moves to his left and makes a stop. A run taken.
Dug in short on off, Moor stands tall and pulls it over mid-wicket. A single taken.
Fullish delivery outside off, played with soft hands to covers.

FOUR! Streaky runs! Fuller length ball around off, Moor pushes at it with hard hands but gets a thick outside edge towards third man. Mathews from deep point covers a lot of ground to his left, slides but his foot touches the boundary cushions as he flicks the ball back in play. The umpires check for it and the replays confirm the same.
Fullish outside off, Peter taps it to cover-point for an easy run. The lead for Zimbabwe moves onto 145.
Flighted on off, Moor with a confident stride forward defends it.
A bit shorter this time, Moor uses the depth of the crease to ease it to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy delivery, Peter lunges forward in defense.
Tossed up around off, spinning in. Moor stays back and defends it.
Dug in short around off, Raza arches his back to let it through.
Back of a length outside off, Sikandar mistimes his cut to covers.
Straying on the pads, worked through backward square leg for a single.

Tailing into Raza this time. He looks to turn it across but gets an inside edge onto his pads and rolls towards square leg. Lakmal is the only one appealing for lbw but the umpire spotted the edge. A run taken.
Length delivery outside off, Sikandar drives it to cover-point.
Fullish delivery outside off, Raza drives it sweetly but finds short extra cover.
Well bowled! Tossed up outside off, goes straight on. Moor plays for the turn but gets beaten.
Spinning in from outside off, Moor looks to defend but gets an inside edge and it hits him on his body.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
5th Test fifty for Sikandar Raza.

Good shot! Fullish delivery outside off, Raza leans forward and creams it through wide mid off. The mid off fielder gives it a chase and keeps the ball in play. Saves a run for his side. That brings up Raza's half century. It has been a confident knock and he needs to carry on for his side.
Floated around off, driven crisply to covers.
Tossed up delivery, played to covers.
Dilruwan Parera back into the attack.
Full length ball on off, stroked to short extra cover.

Full length delivery attacking the stumps, Raza stays leg side of the ball and drives it to mid off to set off. The fielder is quick to attack the ball and has a shy at the striker's end. However, Moor beats him easily.
On a length on off, Raza shuffles a touch and wrists it to short mid-wicket.

Leg bye! Length delivery angling down the leg side, Moor looks to clip it through but is hit on the thigh pad and the ball rolls to the leg side. There is a chirpy appeal for lbw but the umpire shakes his head. The replays show that it was missing the leg stump by a long way.
Fuller length ball on off, eased to short extra cover.
Straying on the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for an easy single.
We are back for the evening session. Sikandar Raza and Peter Moor to continue their innings. Suranga Lakmal to continue his spell. Here we go...
...Day 3, Session 3...

The track has actually played decently with nothing venomous happening so far. Herath is the one on whom Sri Lanka will be banking upon to break this threatening partnership. The visitors on the other hand will be eager to swell the lead to as much as possible. Join us shortly for the final session.

A great fightback from Zimbabwe and they have taken the lead to 136. Raza and Moor have punished the loose balls to keep the scoreboard ticking. The former has struggled with his fitness but has battled on. He is looking solid out there and is the only Zimbabwean batsman who has used his feet with confidence.
Bowls it on leg stump, Raza sweeps it through to fine leg for a run. TEA ON DAY 3.
Very full outside off, Moor drives it through the covers for a run.
Floats it on off, Moor defends it solidly.
Flatter on off, the batsman pushes it to covers.
Bowls a leg spinner on middle, Moor camps back and defends it.
Tosses it on off, Moor defends it off the front foot.
Lands it on a length on off, Raza defends it off the back foot.
Bangs it in short again, Raza does well to evade it.
Bangs it in short on middle, Raza ducks under it.
Good length on off, Raza defends it off the back foot.
Sprays it on the pads, Moor flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Lands it on a length on middle, Peter defends it off the front foot.
Suranga Lakmal is back into the attack.
Drags his length back a little, Moor pushes it down to long off for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Plays a sweep shot down to fine leg for a run.
A tad short outside off, Raza chops it onto the ground and on the bounce to first slip.
Slower through the air, Peter punches it off the back foot through covers for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Moor defends it off the front foot.
Flatter on leg stump, Raza defends it solidly.
Tosses it up on middle, Raza defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Third boundary in the over. Dances down the track and lofts it over mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence.
FOUR! Plays the normal sweep this time to the fine leg fence. Good batting form Raza.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
50-run stand up between Raza and Moor.
FOUR! Raza might just consider himself lucky! Plays the reverse sweep past first slip who tries to anticipate and moves to his right. The ball races to the third man fence.
Bowls it way down the leg side, Raza sweeps it through square leg for a run.
A tad short outside off, Moor cuts it through point for a run.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
Loopy ball outside off, Raza drives it through covers for a run.
Very full on middle, Raza drives it to cover.
Tosses it up on leg stump, Raza defends it off the front foot.
Flatter on middle, Peter defends it off the back foot.
Tosses it up on leg stump, Moor drives it back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Angles it on the stumps, Moor flicks it to mid-wicket.
Again plays the paddle sweep to the ball outside off, down to fine leg for a run.
Paddles it just pass the keeper down to fine leg for a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Goes down on one knee and paddles it through short fine leg for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Bowls it on off, it skids through. The batsman tries to work it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the ground.
FOUR! A long hop by the bowler on the stumps, Peter camps back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bowls a short ball outside off, Moor cuts it through covers. Herath makes good ground and stops it with his right foot. Two runs taken.
Kusal Mendis to have a bowl now. He needs to cover up as Gunaratne is off the field due to a hamstring injury.
Pushes it down to long on for a run.
Comes down the track and flicks it uppishly through mid on for a run.
Drags his length back, Raza whips it through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Bowls it down the leg side, Moor tries to flick but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes down to fine leg for a leg bye. 100 run lead up for Zimbabwe.
Dances down the track and flicks it through wide mid on for a run.
Good news for Sri Lanka. Rangana Herath is back on the field. He also comes back into the attack. The hosts will bank on him to run through the lower middle order.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

NO BALL! What was that? Bowls a high full toss on the chest of the batsman. Moor tries to defend it but gets hit on the glove. He throws his bat immediately. The bowler apologizes. A no ball signaled by the umpire.
Superb from Kusal Mendis! Bowled on the pads, Moor flicks it to the right of short leg. Kusal Mendis dives to his right and makes a good stop.
A well-directed bouncer. Moor ducks under it.
Bangs it in short, Moor defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length, angling  into the batsman. The batsman defends it off the back foot.
Bowled it on the leg stump, Raza flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Plays it with the angle to point.
Flatter on off, Moor defends it solidly.
Floats it on off, Moor defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up on middle, Peter drives it back to the bowler.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Quicker on middle, Peter pushes it back to the bowler.
Low full toss on leg stump, Raza drives it to mid on.
Sprays it down the leg side, Raza lets it through to the keeper.
Bangs it in short, Raza jumps a little and defends it.
Back of a length on middle, Raza defends it off the back foot.
Bowls it on body of the batsman, Raza nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Short on the body, Raza tucks it on the leg side.
Tosses it up on off, Peter defends it solidly.
Drags his length back a little, Moor defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! STREAKY BOUNDARY! Floats it outside off, Peter tries to slog sweep but gets a bottom edge through the keeper's legs and the ball races to the fence.
Plays it with the spin to short leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter on leg, Moor defends it off the back foot.
Raza is receiving some ice treatment near his neck. Zimbabwe will hope that he keeps going. It is important for their cause.

Time for Drinks. Raza and Williams were going along nicely but the latter lost his wicket at a wrong time. Zimbabwe are scoring at a good rate and they would hope that this pair adds as much as possible. A lead of over 150 might get the Lankans worrying.
Full outside off this time, Peter drives it through covers. Chameera the subsitute runs to his right and dives but fails to stop the ball cleanly. The batsmen run three.
Short again on leg stump, Moor defends it with soft hands.
Bangs it in short, Moor does well to evade it.
Back of a length on middle, the batsman pushes it to covers.
Bowls a bouncer on middle, Moor ducks under it.
Comes around the wicket.and bowls it on the leg side, Raza tucks it on the leg side and the batsmen get through for a quick single. Raza is struggling here. He looks uncomfortable.
Very full outside off, Peter misses the slog sweep.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Slower through the air on middle, turns back in. Moor tries to defend it but misses and the ball hits him on the pads. The Lankans appeal but nothing from the umpire. Might be missing leg.
Roshan Abeysinghe on air informs that Rangana Herath has gone off the field. Not sure what the reason is though. Dushmantha Chameera is the substitute fielder in his place.
Plays it with the spin towards square leg for a run.
Floats it on off, Raza defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up on off, the batsman pushes it towards extra cover for a run.
Change of ends for Dilruwan Perera.
Sikandar Raza is taking a bit of a breather. He looks uncomfortable and is hydrating himself. Hope he is fine.
A tad shortish on off, Peter punches it beautifully through covers. Rangana runs to his right, dives and kicks it in with his leg. A good stop by him. The batsmen take three.
FIVE WIDES! Bowls a bouncer but way too short, the ball bounces over the head of the batsman and the keeper for a boundary. The umpire also signals a wide.
Bangs it in short on middle, Moor half pulls it over backward square leg for a couple.
Bowled on the pads, Raza flicks it through backward square leg for a run.
A tad short outside off, Moor guides it through point for a run.
Good length on off, Moor defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length on middle, Moor pushes it to covers.
Lahiru Kumara comes into the attack. A slip, wide gully and leg slip in place.
Flatter on off, Moor gets it off the outside edge past slip for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floats it on middle, goes on with the arm. Moor gets it off the inner half  to short leg.
Tosses it up on off, Moor defends it towards cover.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
That was close! Bowls an arm ball on the leg stump, Moor tries to defend it off the front foot but gets an outside edge which falls short of Karunaratne at first slip.
Fires it in, Moor pushes it through covers for a run.
Quicker on middle, Moor defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter on off, Moor defends it solidly.
Floats it on off, Moor defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up on off, Raza pushes it through covers for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Dances down the track and drives it to long off for a run.
Very full on middle, Moor drives it through covers for a run.
Peter Moor strides out to bat.

OUT! A dream delivery for a left-arm spinner. Tosses it up outside off, Williams tries to drive it through covers but is beaten by the sharp inward turn. The ball goes through the gap between bat and pad and hits the top of off. Sean Williams was playing so well but he has to depart now. Half the side is back in the hut for Zimbabwe. Herath gets his fourth. The Sri Lankans are ecstatic. The visitors only lead by 69 runs.
Flatter outside off, Williams gets an outside edge to backward point.
Tosses it up on middle, Raza drives it to long off for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Sean gets it off the outer half to point.
Paddle sweeps it through short fine leg for a run.
FOUR! These two are going along well here. Floats it outside off, Raza drives it through covers for a boundary.
Flatter on off, Raza defends it off the back foot.
Bowled on the pads, Williams flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Willaims cuts it through point for couple.
Quicker on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Plays it with the spin through the leg side for a run.
Full on off, the batsman clips it to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up on off, Williams drives it through covers for a couple.

He almost converted that into a catch! A brilliant effort by Karunaratne. Raza reverse sweeps a low full toss. Dimuth Karunaratne at first slip anticipates it well. Starts running to his right and dives full stretch. Gets his right hand to it but fails to hang onto it. The ball rolls towards point and they take a single.
Tossed up outside off, Williams pushed it through covers for a run.
Floats it on off, turning in. Raza defends it solidly.
Quicker one on off, Raza drives it to extra cover.
Very full ball on middle, Williams drives it through mid on for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Big appeal from the keeper but nothing from the umpire. Bowls it full on off, does not spin. Sean gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Bowls it outside off, Raza paddle sweeps it through short fine leg for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Williams defends it solidly.
Runs down the track and drives it down to long off for a run.
Plays it with the spin through square leg for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tries to play the reverse sweep again but misses and it hits him on the pads. There is a stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire.
It has turned a bit gloomy. Let's hope the rain stays away.
Brings out the reverse sweep to good effect through third man for a couple.
Quicker on middle and leg, Raza gets it off the inner half on the bounce to short leg.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Raza punches it off the back foot through covers for a couple.
Drags his length back a little, Williams cuts it through covers for a run.
Floats it on off, turning away. Sean defends it solidly.
Flighted ball on off, Sean defends it off the front foot.
Short and on off, Raza cuts it through point for a run.
BEATEN! Full and wide outside off, this one does not turn. Williams tries to drive it but gets beaten. The keeper fumbles and fails to collect it.
BEAUTIFUL BOWLING! Tosses it wide outside off, the ball turns in sharply off the footmarks. Sean tries to drive it but misses. The ball goes through bat and pad and just misses the off pole.
Loopy ball on middle, Sean prods forward and defends it off the front foot.
Full ball on middle, Raza drives it down to long off for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Williams plays it with soft hands on the off side for a run.
FOUR! GREAT SHOT! Quicker outside off, Williams strokes it through covers for a boundary. He played that really well.
Flatter and on the shorter side on the stumps, Raza pushes it to mid on.
Short and wide outside off, Sean cuts it through point for a run.
Plays it with the turn on the leg side for a run.
Dances down the track and defends it.
Drags his length back, turning away. Williams pushes it through covers for a run.
Flighted on middle, Sean defends it off the front foot.
Floats it on off stump, Sean plays it with soft hands towards cover. He sets off for a run but then stops but goes through with it eventually.
Bowls it wide outside off, Williams shoulders his arms to it.
Works it with the spin to short leg.
Tosses it on off, Williams defends it off the front foot.
Gives it air and bowls it full on off, Sean drives it to mid off.
Bowls it outside off, the batsman lets it through to the keeper.
Rangana Herath to continue his spell.
Flatter on the pads, Raza plays it on the bounce to short leg.
Tosses it up outside off, turning away. Sean drives it through covers for a run.
Plays the paddle sweep straightaway down to fine leg for a run. Raza is off the mark.

We are back for the afternoon session. The players and the umpires are out in the middle. Sikandar Raza to join Sean Williams at the crease. Dilruwan Perera to continue his over. A slip and short leg in place. Here we go...
...Day 3, Session 2...

Zimbabwe are in need of a big partnership. The wicket is getting very difficult to bat on and run scoring won't be easy. But as we have seen throughout this Test match the tourists have always come out fighting after the lunch break. We are in for an eventful second session of play. Join us in a while.

The Sri lankan spinners have bamboozled the visitors. They have ran through the Zimbabwean top order and are convincingly on top at the moment. Rangana Herath has waved his magic and bagged three wickets and Dilruwan has taken the centurion of the first innings. The home side would want to continue the same and wrap things up quickly after the break.

OUT! Zimbabwe are in dire straits now! They are falling down like a pack of cards! The star for the visitors in the first innings has thrown it away. On the shorter side of things around off, spinning away. Ervine pokes at it with an open bat face aiming to guide it past first slip. However, he finds Karunaratne in that region to perfection who takes another fine catch, this time by bending low. Craig could have left that delivery. The hosts are not being able to cope up with the pressure. Sri Lankan players head back to their dressing room with big smiles on their faces. In contrast, their opposition camp will be dejected. With that, LUNCH HAS BEEN TAKEN!
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Long hop from Perera. Ervine lines it up and pulls it through mid-wicket to find the fence.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, left alone.
Quicker one, catches the outside edge of Ervine's bat and goes past slip. A run taken.
Tossed up around off, Ervine fails to get on top of the bounce and gets a top edge towards short fine leg but it falls short of the fielder.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Sean Williams comes out to bat.

OUT! The on-field call stays! The wily old customer is ruling the roost in home conditions. Tosses this one around off and gets it to slide in with the angle. Masakadza kneels and goes for the sweep but is pinged on the back pad. A loud shout in unison from the hosts and the umpire rules it out. Hamilton however opts to take the review straightaway. Time for the replays. There is no inside edge involved. The Hawk Eye shows three reds and he is a dead duck. Zimbabwe slip further.
Masakadza has been given out LBW. He reviews straightaway. Looks out.

The umpire was in the firing line there! Tossed up in line of the stumps, Masakadza uses his feet and drills it down to the stumps at the bowler's end. Luckily, it hit the stumps or umpire Ian Gould could have been in danger.
Quicker one on middle and leg, Ervine turns it to the right side of the bowler who stops it.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Quicker one outside off, chopped to point.
Flatter on off, played off the outer half to point.
Quicker delivery on leg stump, Masakadza turns it to square leg.
Ervine uses his feet and blocks it.
Ervine tries to defend it but the ball hits him on the pads.
Craig Ervine is the new man in.

OUT! Poor choice of shot and he pays the price for it! Tossed up on middle, spinning away. Musakanda looks to hit it hard down the ground but gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies to first slip. Karunaratne stationed there is alert and takes a sharp catch, good reflexes by him. Herath is dominating with the new ball. Zimbabwe lead by 26 runs.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Tarisai keeps it out.
Quicker again but sliding down leg, Musakanda misses his flick to get hit on the pads. A shout for an lbw is turned down.
Coming in with the arm, Musakanda prods forward to defend.
Back of a length delivery around off, Hamilton has a push at it but gets it off the inner half to mid on.
A surprise delivery from Lakmal. Bangs this one short, Hamilton ducks under it.
Danushka Gunathilaka is on the field for Asela Gunaratne who has a hamstring problem.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Fuller length ball outside off, Masakadza drives it crisply to sweeper cover. The fielder moves to his right to cut it off. Two runs taken.
This one shapes in from outside off, pushed to mid on.
Length delivery outside off, shaping away. Masakadza stays deep in the crease and blocks it.

Flatter delivery on off, Musakanda comes forward tentatively but gets an inside edge onto his pads. There was a slight gap between bat and pad and thankfully for him, it didn't go through the gate. A wicket maiden for Herath.
Tossed up on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Quicker delivery on middle and leg, defended off the inner half to short leg.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, defended solidly.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tarisai Musakanda comes out to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Chakabva didn't have any clue about it and Herath is all pumped up! Tosses this one up on middle on a bit of a shortish length. Chakabva hangs deep in the crease and expects it to come in with the arm. However, it spins away to catch him off guard and knocks the bail of off stump. Poor outing for Regis in this match. With around 20 minutes left for the lunch break, Sri Lanka will be aiming to get a couple of more breakthroughs.
Straying on the hips, Chakabva tucks it around the corner for a single.
Length delivery around off, Regis covers the line and defends it.
Similar length delivery outside off, holding its line. Chakabva doesn't fiddle with it.
Good length delivery outside off, Regis points his bat skywards to allow it through.
Four Leg byes! Leg stump line this time, Regis Chakabva looks to tuck it away but the ball brushes his thigh pad and flies past the keeper to the fine leg fence. Four leg byes signaled by the umpire.
Back of a length outside off, Chakabva camps back and defends it.
Loopy delivery, Hamilton lunges forward in defense.
That was risky! Flatter delivery on off, Regis rocks back and cuts it to sweeper cover for a run. That could have easily gone through his defenses.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The wily Herath bowls with a lot of guile! Pushes this quicker through the air, comes in with the arm. Regis is hurried by it as he looks to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short outside off, going straight on. Chakabva hangs back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Good delivery to begin with! Tossed up on off, turning away. Chakabva leans forward to counter it but gets an outside edge that rolls past slip. He played that with soft hands.
Rangana Herath to share the new ball from the other end.
Similar delivery outside off, slight away shape on that. Hamilton doesn't fiddle with it.
A bit fuller outside off, in the fifth stump line. Masakadza plants his front foot across and lets it go.
Length delivery on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
FOUR! Zimbabwe are away! Short of a length outside off, holding its line. Masakadza stands tall and cracks it through covers to find the fence. Hit that with a lot of authority.
Good length delivery around off, angling in. Hamilton covers the line and defends it stoutly.
Back of a length outside off, Masakadza hangs back and pushes it to covers.
